title: CMs of the same subtype show different maturation-associated RNA patterns
legend: a,b, Ventricular-associated CM labels at P0 and P7. c,d, Relative position within the section’s 21-gene maturation-score distribution. e,f, Score distributions within each CM subtype. A high score indicates stronger expression of the measured panel, rather than a direct measurement of CM function. Labels and coordinates are retained from the earlier analysis. Scale bars, 500 µm.

title: Fibroblasts develop different matrix-associated features
legend: a, RNA programs across ages and fibroblast groups, averaged over the two libraries and shown relative to the other displayed groups. b, Gene patterns in named P21 RNA subgroups; dot size shows detection and color shows relative expression. c, Earlier P14 matched Col8a1/Gfpt2 comparison: proximity to arterial structures and the smooth-muscle share of neighboring cells are separate measures. These values use the earlier conservative labels, not the new classifier labels. d, Selected RNA-signature similarities with interpreted markers withheld. Dashed arrows mark comparisons to test; they do not trace cell descendants.

title: Alternative methods recover broader fibroblast candidate maps
legend: a–d, Candidate fibroblast identities on the four original sections. e, Assignment coverage among eligible broad fibroblasts. Coverage is not subtype abundance or an independently measured accuracy. f, P21 agreement between whole-cell and boundary-core labels, compared with random loss of whole-cell transcripts to similar depth. This helps separate loss of information from sensitivity to transcript location. Nuclear alternatives remain review flags. Gray retains profiles without a confident candidate; scale bars, 500 µm.

title: A Gfpt2-associated pattern extends beyond the narrow subtype
legend: a, Public named fibroblast labels within the eligible P21 cohort. b, Multi-method cell candidates. c, The subset also supported in the cell core and after naming markers are hidden. d, Direct Gfpt2/Pi16/Adgrd1 marker score relative to matched control genes. e,f, Gfpt2/Col8a1 pattern combinations across eligible fibroblasts or within the public Gfpt2 subset. A pattern-positive profile is not automatically a member of one subtype. Public valve labels are not equated with Kirrel3 candidates. Gray and review flags retain uncertainty; scale bars, 500 µm.

title: Vascular growth and CM maturation have different relationships over time
legend: a, Regional vascular sequence from Lu et al. (2021), rather than a new measurement of blood flow. b, Earlier P7 cycling-CM/Postn-fibroblast metabolic association under different source rules and distances. This result becomes less convincing when the full set of tested relationships is considered. c, Earlier P14 Ankrd1-CM/endocardial-EC sarcomere association. Intervals summarize uncertainty within a section. d, Earlier matched comparison of CMs alongside capillary ECs with comparable CMs without that proximity; this uses a broader CM cohort. e, Vessel growth, local access and functional support are different measurements. The newest classifier-based FB labels have not been used to refit these estimates.

title: Some cellular environments resemble one another across ages
legend: a, Comparison design, restricted to the same CM subtype and a similar position relative to the endocardium. b, Earlier strict fibroblast/endothelial descriptors in 96 observed neighborhoods. c,d, Agreement between Wormhole and exact neighborhood distances. e, Similarity of environments around the same or different CM subtypes within an age. f, Relative maturation-rank agreement was checked after matching, rather than used to choose matches. Results vary by region and age. New FB labels do not alter these plans; no individual cells or descendants were followed.

title: Experiments can separate blood supply, matrix and contact effects
legend: a, Proposed sequence of early growth followed by later specialization. The arrows show developmental windows, not observed cell conversion. b, Blood supply, matrix/mechanics and cellular contact are different possible contributions to CM development. c, Independent intermediate-stage hearts, controlled functional experiments and lineage tracing can distinguish them. Direct measurements should include perfusion, CM energy use, calcium handling and contraction. This is a model to test, rather than a completed causal experiment.

title: The reference tests show why more labels need not mean better assignments
legend: a, P21 Gfpt2 precision and recall in opposite-library RNA tests; each point is one held-out library. b, Mean RNA-label recovery by family and method. c, Sensitivity to hidden naming markers and pooled late references. d, Sensitivity to reduced RNA information. These tests recover our reviewed RNA definitions; they do not establish independent Xenium accuracy. Some methods recover more Gfpt2 nuclei while also assigning other families incorrectly.

title: Hidden genes help check assignments, while marker patterns can overlap
legend: a, Measured P21 expression after grouping with classifiers that could not use the seven naming/anchor genes. Printed values show detection percentages. b, Gfpt2/Col8a1 pattern combinations among eligible profiles with public Gfpt2 labels. c, Published marker coverage in the shared panel. The valve set has too few measured genes for a multi-gene module. d, A candidate subtype, a measured marker pattern and developmental fate describe different kinds of evidence.
